findings.claim: add_gap accepts a present non-string label instead of refusing labels outside the verified|inferred vocabulary.
findings.evidence: The learn-model-coherence spec says `add_gap SHALL refuse ... a label outside verified | inferred with an error reply`; the add_gap dispatch matches `params["label"].as_str()` and treats `None | Some("") => None`, so `{"label":123}` or `{"label":true}` is accepted as if the label were absent.
findings.suggested_fix: Inspect the raw JSON value: accept missing/null/empty string only as absent, accept strings `verified` or `inferred`, and return an error for any other present value or string.
